title: Chet (het), 8: represents new beginnings
summary: The letter chet (het, ח), number 8, represents new beginnings. Examples: after 7 days of Creation comes a new beginning; 8 people on the Ark (Noah, Shem, Ham, Japheth and their wives); the musical scale Do Re Mi Fa Sol La Ti begins a new octave; and the seven-day week (Su to Sa) begins a new week.

text.text: After 7 days of Creation → A New Beginning.
Noah, Shem, Ham, Japheth & their Wives
Do, Re, Mi, Fa, Sol, La Ti → A New Octave.
Su, Mo, Tu, We, Th, Fr, Sa → A New Week.
